forbidden_runtime_api_notes.Image: Bare Image is not scanned (too many false positives). Match new Image( and HTMLImageElement as the Image constructor / element surface from section 3.1.
forbidden_runtime_api_notes.createObjectURL: Not listed as a hard token: FormMaster mesh JSON download may use object URLs for non-image files. SVG-to-image / blob snapshot substitution is still forbidden via new Image(, drawImage, canvas, XMLSerializer, and transition snapshot tokens.
forbidden_runtime_api_notes.XMLSerializer: Forbidden when used to serialize live SVG for image/canvas decode substitution.
forbidden_runtime_api_notes.setAttribute filter: VEC-302: forbids runtime SVG filter attribute writes on organism nodes.
forbidden_runtime_api_notes.mix-blend-mode: VEC-302: forbids CSS mix-blend-mode compositing as organism material authority.

forbidden_svg_raster_media_notes.scope: Applied only to .svg source files under scan roots. SVG is scanned as raw source — no JavaScript comment stripping.
forbidden_svg_raster_media_notes.href_src_extensions: Bare raster extensions (.png, .jpg, .jpeg, .webp, .gif, .bmp, .avif) catch href/src/xlink:href raster-file references and inline paths in SVG.
forbidden_svg_raster_media_notes.image_element: <image forbids SVG image element embedding of bitmaps or external rasters.
forbidden_svg_raster_media_notes.foreignObject: <foreignObject / <foreignobject forbids HTML/canvas hosts inside the live SVG organism root.
forbidden_svg_raster_media_notes.data_image: data:image/ forbids inline raster data URIs as organism media.
forbidden_svg_raster_media_notes.image_rendering: image-rendering forbids pixel-sampling/CSS bitmap presentation hints on organism SVG.
forbidden_svg_raster_media_notes.image_space: VEC-302: forbidden_svg_image_space_markers ban filter primitives, filter attributes, mix-blend-mode, masks, and CSS image-space compositing. Geometric clipPath remains allowed.
